items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIII, List of Answers on Terminology 78:1
items.html: The ten Sefirot of the hairs, which are the garments of the revealed AB that remained in the head after its departure in the aspect of a returning surrounding light, as is known — they too received the correction of the MEM-LAMED-TZADIK, like the inner vessels of Arich Anpin, in which the aspect of the MEM in them came out upon the Galgalta in the aspect of the hairs of the head, and the aspect of the LAMED-TZADIK in them came out in the aspect of the hairs of the beard. Hence the hairs of the head are called pure wool, because the correction of the MEM, which is the aspect of the first three of Bina, over which no restriction or judgment can rule, as is known, makes them clean of all restriction and judgment. And it is in the manner of the Galgalta itself, which is called Avir dakia, for the same reason, as is known. (Page 328, Items 74 and 87).
